50d26b02-a772-41e7-b684-8c19fadccb37.quote: We owned the neutral map: all three Fangtooths, the Genesis Core and the Primal Fangtooth were ours, and we lost only one of seven recorded fights. GRIM.exe finished with zero kills and the most deaths in the game. The towers were sloppier. After the first Fangtooth they took two of our outer towers before we took one, and after the Genesis Core the next tower to fall was our inner. We finished three towers to their four and still closed it.
